units.source_text: 我常常和无聊的父亲下将棋玩。

en.t: I often played shogi with my bored father.

units.source_text: 父子俩都很懒散，所以一边烤着被炉一边下棋。

en.t: Both father and son were lazy, so we played while warming ourselves at the kotatsu.

units.source_text: 棋盘放在被炉的木框罩上，走棋时，才把手从棉被下面伸出来。

en.t: We put the board on the wooden frame of the kotatsu and only pulled our hands out from under the quilt when making a move.

units.source_text: 可笑的是，我们时常弄丢棋子，直到开始新的一局时才发现。

en.t: The funny thing was that we often lost pieces and did not notice until we started a new game.

units.source_text: 每当此时，母亲就用火筷子从炉灰里把棋子夹出来。

en.t: Whenever that happened, my mother would pick the pieces out of the ashes with fire tongs.

units.source_text: “围棋的棋盘太高，还有腿，在被炉上没法下，

en.t: The go board is too high and has legs, so you cannot play it on the kotatsu,

units.source_text: 还是下将棋好，多舒服啊，最适合懒人了。

en.t: but shogi is better; it is so comfortable and just right for lazy people.
All right, let us play another game.

units.source_text: 父亲赢的时候准说再来一盘吧，不过输的时候，他也会说再来一盘。

en.t: When my father won, he was sure to say, let us play another game, but even when he lost, he would say the same thing.

units.source_text: 总之，不论输赢，他总是喜欢围着被炉下棋。

en.t: In short, whether he won or lost, he always liked playing shogi around the kotatsu.

units.source_text: 起初，我觉得很新鲜，这种隐居式的娱乐也引起了我极大的兴趣，

en.t: At first I found it fresh and new, and this secluded sort of amusement greatly interested me,

units.source_text: 然而时间一长，这样的刺激便满足不了我旺盛的精力了，

en.t: but as time went on, that kind of stimulation could no longer satisfy my restless energy,

units.source_text: 我常常忍不住把握着“金”和“香车”的拳头举到头上打哈欠。

en.t: and I often could not help raising the fist that held the gold general and lance above my head as I yawned.
I thought of life in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 于是，我仿佛听到从自己血流奔涌的心脏里发出的“活动、活动”的持续不断的鼓动声。

en.t: Then I seemed to hear a constant pulse of activity, activity, rising from the heart where my blood surged.

units.source_text: 我感到那鼓动声，由某种微妙的意识状态，不可思议地被先生的力量加强了。

en.t: I felt that, through some subtle state of consciousness, that pulse was being mysteriously strengthened by Sensei's power.
